steps.title: Initialize Project Configurations
steps.description: Configure build system files, Gradle settings, target SDKs, and basic parameters.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Define compile target parameters, targetSdkVersion, source compatibility, and dependencies setup inside build.gradle.

steps.title: Configure Manifest and Security Policies
steps.description: Define package structure, activities mapping, and request necessary networking permissions in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Design Card Container Drawables
steps.description: Develop card shapes with custom rounding, solid white backgrounds, and light-grey strokes.

steps.title: Design Input Field and Button Themes
steps.description: Create standard shapes for form fields, active states, and custom action buttons.

steps.title: Build Authentication Layouts
steps.description: Formulate interface UI designs for logging in and signing up, incorporating loading spinners.

steps.title: Create Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Design main application board with overall summary indicators, categorized metrics, and action triggers.

steps.title: Create Form Editor and Item Views
steps.description: Build templates for creating/editing transactions, date fields, spinner components, and raw items row layouts.

steps.title: Implement API and Data Client Connection logic
steps.description: Create BackendApi client using standard HttpURLConnection. Support parsing of dynamic login tokens and credentials.

steps.title: Implement Model Data Structures
steps.description: Establish basic transactional schemas for local execution, including parser bindings to extract backend collection records.

steps.title: Implement Authentication Gateways
steps.description: Implement LoginActivity sequence verifying existing persistence headers, credentials verification, and redirection.

steps.title: Implement Account Registration logic
steps.description: Handle signup execution, triggering automatic credential logging protocols immediately on user registration success.

steps.title: Implement Form Controller actions
steps.description: Assemble transaction form parameters handling dynamic calendars, database creation, structural editing, and deletion requests.

steps.title: Implement Main Dashboard Engine
steps.description: Retrieve financial list logs asynchronously, parse records, calculate statistics, and build visual item lists.

steps.title: Building Expense Manager
steps.description: Assemble clean packages and perform compiler target tests verifying network persistence operations.
